benefits.text: BBIA Never Die Brush Eyeliner features a soft brush tip with Ink Tank technology, which helps regulate ultra-fine black carbon particles to create ultra-thin, seamless lines. Even, intense color in just one stroke. Its unique film technology delivers excellent water resistance and color that lasts up to 6-7 hours, even on oily eyelids.

howToUse.text:
Gently twist the pen to expose the tip.
Draw along the lash line from the inner corner outward for a sharp, precise line.
For best results, apply eyeliner after your basic eye makeup and make sure the eye area is dry.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

sellingPoints.text: Soft brush tip; Ink Tank technology for ultra-thin, seamless lines; film technology helps provide water resistance and color that lasts up to 6–7 hours.

texture.text: Liquid eyeliner with a soft brush tip, ink flows evenly.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not use claims of absolute waterproofing or 100% smudge-proof. The long-wear claim should read “up to 6–7 hours” per the documentation, not be extended to all day.

positioning.text: Liquid eyeliner pen with a soft brush tip that helps create ultra-thin, seamless and sharp lines in just one stroke.
Liquid eyeliner pen with a soft brush tip that helps create ultra-thin, seamless and sharp lines, but softer than pure black.

finish.text: Matte / soft yet defined / more natural than black.
